description: Unison Helper: it spreads one V/Oct signal into a detuned polyphonic one for other makers' oscillators, then collects their audio back into a stereo unison

params.text: Spreads the unison voices in pitch, over 100 cents, or 1200 cents when the range is widened.
Adds a slow random pitch wander to each voice, for an analogue feel.
Cuts the low frequencies out of the collected audio.
Cuts the high frequencies out of the collected audio.
Sets how many unison voices the V/Oct input is spread into, 1 to 9.
Widens the detune range from 100 cents to 1200 cents.
Sets a fixed filter on the output: Warm, Neutral or Bright.
Switches the low cut filter on.
Switches the high cut filter on.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.

inputs.text: Takes the V/Oct signal to be spread; one channel here becomes as many channels as the voice count.
Takes the audio back from the oscillator fed by the V/Oct output of the same number.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

outputs.text: The left channel of the collected unison.
The right channel of the collected unison.
Carries part of the spread V/Oct signal, to be patched into an oscillator.

notes: up to four oscillators can be driven, which allows 64 unison voices in total; nine voices across seven notes, or four voices across sixteen.
This module makes no sound of its own: patch each of its V/Oct outputs into an oscillator and bring that oscillator's audio back into the matching input.
A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
